description: North Carolina motorcycle delta: helmet law and lane rules. National riding skills stay in core_motorcycle.json.

questions.q: A North Carolina motorcycle learner permit is valid for
options: 12 months, renewable once for six months
30 days, renewable as often as needed
Three years, the same as a driver license
Until the rider turns 18, then it expires
questions.explanation: G.S. 20-7 issues the motorcycle learner permit for 12 months; it may be renewed once for six months.

questions.q: To apply for a North Carolina motorcycle learner permit, you must already hold
options: A full provisional, regular or commercial driver license
Nothing more than a birth certificate and proof of address
A moped registration and a valid motor vehicle insurance card
A limited learner permit for a car held for at least 12 months
questions.explanation: Applicants need a full provisional, regular or commercial license, and must pass the motorcycle knowledge, road sign and vision tests.

questions.q: Who must wear a helmet on a motorcycle in North Carolina?
questions.explanation: North Carolina helmet law: all riders and passengers.

provenance.manual: G.S. 20-140.4. Special provisions for motorcycles and mopeds.

questions.q: What does North Carolina law say about riding a motorcycle between lanes of traffic?
options: Only lane filtering is allowed, when traffic is stopped or slow
Riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed
questions.explanation: North Carolina: riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed.
